answer: One concrete defense is reciprocal vouching with slashed bonds: each new agent identity must be endorsed by an existing, independently verified counterparty whose staked capital is burned if that identity turns out to be a duplicate. Forging a thousand sock puppets therefore means recruiting a thousand real backers willing to risk real money, so the orchard of fake accounts cannot grow for free. Every extra identity carries a bond, making the attack cost far more than any reward. Attestations hard as quartz let anyone audit the vouches, and only ships that paid the toll enter the harbor.
